note.zh-TW: 老師自訂的說法。課程只用文字說明這個概念，沒有給公式；網站補上計算公式，並標示「網站補充定義」。
note.en: A teacher-defined term. The course explains the idea in words only, without a formula; the site adds a formula and labels it as a site definition.

definition.zh-TW:
課程自訂的說法：把營收比上一期增加的金額，和本期的研究發展費用相比，觀察營收的成長相對於研發投入有多大。

課程只用文字說明這個概念，沒有給公式；網站補充一個定義供計算器使用，屬於延伸內容，目前不出計分題。
definition.en:
A term coined in the course: the increase in revenue over the previous period, set against research and development expenses for this period, to see how large the growth is relative to research spending.

The course explains the idea in words without a formula; the site supplies a working definition for the calculator as extension content, and it is not currently used in scored questions.

example.zh-TW: 需要輸入前期營業收入才能計算；沒有輸入或研發費用為 0 時顯示 N/A。本課故事沒有研發費用。
example.en: The calculator needs last period’s revenue as an input; without it, or when research spending is zero, the result is N/A. The course story has no research expense.

misconception.zh-TW: 把它和 RD intensity 當成同一件事。RD intensity 只用本期的兩個數字，看研發費用占營收的比例；RD leverage 要用前後兩期的營收，看的是營收的變動，兩者回答的問題不同。
misconception.en: Treating it as the same thing as RD intensity. RD intensity uses only two figures from this period and shows research spending as a share of revenue; RD leverage needs revenue for two periods and looks at the change in revenue, so the two answer different questions.

formula.zh-TW: 網站補充定義：RD leverage ＝（本期營業收入 － 前期營業收入）÷ 本期研究發展費用。分子是兩期營收的差額，所以要另外輸入前期營業收入。網站不採用「營業收入 ÷ 研究發展費用」：它正好是 RD intensity 的倒數，資訊相同。另一種寫法是把兩期營收的差額除以兩期研究發展費用的差額（邊際版本），需要兩期的研究發展費用，費用持平時無法計算，所以也不採用。
formula.en: Site definition: RD leverage = (revenue this period － revenue last period) ÷ research and development expenses this period. The numerator is the difference between the two periods’ revenue, so last period’s revenue has to be entered separately. The site does not use revenue ÷ research and development expenses, because that is simply the reciprocal of RD intensity and carries the same information. Another version divides the change in revenue by the change in research and development expenses (a marginal version); it needs research and development expenses for both periods and cannot be calculated when the spending stays flat, so the site does not use it either.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率，這個名稱是課程自訂的說法；網站的公式標示「網站補充定義」。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios, and this name was coined in the course; the site formula is marked as a site definition.
